# Owen Ford

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed thirty or thirty-five  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** newspaper man  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Owen Ford is a tall, broad-shouldered man with thick, brown hair. He has large, brilliant dark-gray eyes, paired with a finely-cut nose and chin.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008)_

## Personality

Owen Ford is motivated to write a novel based on the contents of Captain Jim's life-book. He is confident that using this material will allow him to create the novel of the year.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000)_

## History

Owen Ford is a newspaper writer and short-story author, as well as the grandson of Alice [Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) and the local schoolmaster, who came to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) to recover from a severe spell of typhoid. Upon meeting Captain Jim, Owen read the old man's life-book and received his enthusiastic permission to adapt his sea tales and memories into a novel, which Owen completed by the end of the summer. During his stay, he secretly fell deeply in love with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), confessing his feelings to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who advised him to leave in silence due to Leslie's circumstances. After returning later, Owen declared his love to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) in the garden, and she joyfully returned his feelings.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P22](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P27](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), +13 more_

## Quotes

> "Mrs. Blythe, this is a wonderful book—absolutely wonderful. If I could take it and use the material for a book I feel certain I could make the novel of the year out of it. Do you suppose Captain Jim would let me do it?"
>
> — Owen Ford — [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000)

> "You will give the soul and I the body. Oh, we’ll write a famous book between us, Captain Jim. And we’ll get right to work."
>
> — Owen Ford — [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)

> "but in the main it’s done. I wrote the last sentence this morning. If I can find a publisher for it it will probably be out next summer or fall."
>
> — Owen Ford — [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P19](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0019)

> "Yes—love triumphant and perfect. Leslie, you know—you understand. I have loved you from the first. And I KNOW you love me—I don’t need to ask you. But I want to hear you say it—my darling—my darling!"
>
> — Owen Ford — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009)

> "Yes,—he’s mentally deficient, or something of the sort, isn’t he? But she said nothing about Mrs. Moore, and I supposed she’d be the usual hustling country housewife who takes in boarders to earn an honest penny."
>
> — Owen Ford — [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P30](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0030)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--owen-ford.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Owen Ford are close friends and correspondents. After introducing Owen to [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) and Captain Jim, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) supports his writing ambitions and joins him on summer outings. Owen confides his secret love for [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who offers him sympathetic advice on the situation.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), +13 more_

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/leslie-moore--owen-ford.md)

Owen Ford and [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) develop mutual romantic feelings after meeting through [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Though Owen initially leaves in silence regarding his love, he later returns to court her. In the garden, Owen declares his love to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and she joyfully returns his affection.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), +18 more_

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/owen-ford--uncle-jim.md)

Captain Jim and Owen Ford become close comrades and literary collaborators. After meeting at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, Captain Jim entrusts Owen with his prized life-book, giving his enthusiastic approval for Owen to adapt his sea tales and memories into a novel. Upon the book's completion, Captain Jim bestows a loving farewell blessing on Owen.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P27](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), +11 more_
